name: CERT-In (Indian Computer Emergency Response Team)
description: India's national agency for responding to cyber security incidents. Issues advisories, vulnerability notes, and incident reporting.

name: Indian Cyber Crime Coordination Centre (I4C)
description: Official Government of India portal for reporting cybercrimes. Categories: financial fraud, social media, ransomware, hacking, etc.

name: CISA (Cybersecurity & Infrastructure Security Agency)
description: U.S. federal agency with extensive guides, alerts, and resources for individuals and organizations.

name: NIST (National Institute of Standards and Technology)
description: Develops cybersecurity standards and guidelines (NIST CSF, SP 800 series). Gold standard for security frameworks.

name: OWASP (Open Web Application Security Project)
description: Nonprofit foundation improving software security. Famous for OWASP Top 10 web application security risks.

name: ISO/IEC 27001
description: International standard for Information Security Management Systems (ISMS). Certification standard.

name: PCI DSS (Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard)
description: Security standards for organizations that handle credit card information.

name: The Hacker News
description: Leading cybersecurity news platform covering breaches, vulnerabilities, and threat intelligence.

name: Krebs on Security
description: Investigative security journalism by Brian Krebs. Deep dives into cybercrime operations.

name: BleepingComputer
description: Technical news, tutorials, and support forums for computer security and technology.

name: Dark Reading
description: Enterprise-focused cybersecurity news, analysis, and research from industry experts.

name: Have I Been Pwned?
description: Check if your email/phone has been compromised in known data breaches. By Troy Hunt.

name: No More Ransom
description: Free decryption tools for various ransomware variants. Initiative by Europol, Kaspersky, McAfee.

name: VirusTotal
description: Free online service analyzing files/URLs for malware using 70+ antivirus engines.

name: URLhaus
description: Malware URL exchange platform. Check if a URL is distributing malware.

name: MITRE ATT&CK
description: Globally-accessible knowledge base of adversary tactics and techniques based on real-world observations.

name: NIST Cybersecurity Framework (CSF)
description: Voluntary framework helping organizations manage and reduce cybersecurity risk.

name: CIS Controls
description: Prioritized set of actions to protect organizations from known cyber attack vectors.

name: RBI (Reserve Bank of India) Cybersecurity Guidelines
description: Cybersecurity framework for banks and financial institutions in India.

name: TRAI (Telecom Regulatory Authority of India)
description: Regulations for telecom security, SIM swap protection, and consumer protection.

name: NCIIPC (National Critical Information Infrastructure Protection Centre)
description: Nodal agency for protecting Critical Information Infrastructure in India.

name: Cyber Swachhta Kendra
description: Botnet cleaning and malware analysis center by CERT-In. Free tools for citizens.

name: Google Safety Center
description: Google's resources for online safety, privacy controls, and family safety.

name: Microsoft Security
description: Microsoft's security resources, best practices, and threat intelligence reports.

name: Stay Safe Online (NCSA)
description: National Cyber Security Alliance resources for individuals, families, and businesses.

name: ENISA (EU Agency for Cybersecurity)
description: European Union agency dedicated to achieving a high common level of cybersecurity across Europe.
